title: Public Alert No. 06/2026 – Alert on Revalidated Infant Formula (SMA Gold) Found on Sale

products.brand: SMA GOLD From Birth First Infant Milk

summary: NAFDAC alerts the public to revalidated (date-altered) SMA Gold From Birth First Infant Milk 900g found on sale in Kaduna State. Expiry/manufacture stickers were tampered with; an infant reportedly had diarrhoea after consumption.
